name: Armenia

fees.name: E-Visa - Visitor visa (up to 21 days of stay)
fees.validity: Single entry, up to 21 days of stay
fees.notes: Non-refundable fee, published on the official MFA e-visa portal as USD 8 (equivalent to AMD 3,000 in the MFA consular fee table). Extension possible up to 60 extra days at the Migration and Citizenship Service.

fees.name: E-Visa - Visitor visa (up to 120 days of stay)
fees.validity: Single entry, up to 120 days of stay
fees.notes: Non-refundable. Portal lists USD 38; MFA consular fee table lists AMD 15,000 / USD 39 for the same category at embassies.

fees.name: E-Visa - Multiple-entry visitor visa (up to 60 days of stay, 6-month validity)
fees.validity: Multiple entry, 6-month validity, up to 60 days of stay
fees.notes: Multiple-entry e-visa: 60 days of stay within 6-month validity at USD 52, per the MFA e-visa policy note.

fees.name: E-Visa - Multiple-entry visitor visa (up to 120 days of stay, 1-year validity)
fees.validity: Multiple entry, 1-year validity, up to 120 days of stay
fees.notes: Multiple-entry e-visa: 120 days of stay within 1-year validity at USD 103, per the MFA e-visa policy note.

fees.name: Visitor visa at embassy/consulate (up to 21 days of stay)
fees.applies: all nationalities that require a visa
fees.notes: MFA consular fee table valid from 1 Jan 2026: AMD 3,000 / USD 8 / EUR 7 / RUB 700. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Visitor visa at embassy/consulate (up to 120 days of stay)
fees.applies: all nationalities that require a visa

fees.name: Multiple-entry visitor visa (up to 60 days of stay, 6-month validity)
fees.validity: Multiple entry, 6 months, up to 60 days of stay
fees.applies: all nationalities that require a visa

fees.name: Multiple-entry visitor visa (up to 120 days of stay, 1-year validity)
fees.validity: Multiple entry, 1 year, up to 120 days of stay
fees.applies: all nationalities that require a visa

fees.name: Single-entry transit visa
fees.applies: all nationalities that require a visa

fees.name: Multiple-entry transit visa (1-year validity)
fees.applies: all nationalities that require a visa

fees.name: Visitor visa on arrival at border crossing points
fees.validity: Single entry, up to 21 days (AMD 3,000) or up to 120 days (AMD 15,000)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities at Zvartnots/Gyumri airports and land border points
fees.notes: State-duty amounts mirror the visitor visa schedule (AMD 3,000 for 21 days, AMD 15,000 for 120 days). The current MFA visa page emphasizes the e-visa route and does not restate VOA amounts explicitly, so this row is corroborated by the MFA consular fee schedule plus secondary sources rather than a dedicated official VOA fee page.

vfs.note: Armenia does not route visa applications through VFS Global, TLScontact or BLS; applications go via the official e-visa portal (evisa.mfa.am), Armenian embassies/consulates, or on arrival.

free_visa_notes: Not free for everyone, but broad exemptions: nationals of many countries are visa-exempt unilaterally or by agreement (EU/EEA, CIS, and others; lists at mfa.am/en/visafreelist and mfa.am/en/whoneedvisa) and may stay up to 180 days per year. Temporary exemption 1 Jul 2026-1 Jul 2027 for nationals of 111 countries holding a residence permit (valid 6+ months from entry) issued by the USA, EU/Schengen states, UAE, Bahrain, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait or Oman. Official and diplomatic visas are free. Some nationalities can apply only with an invitation at embassies (invitation state duty AMD 5,000, paid by the inviter).
